name: ISO 9001:2015
description: International standard for quality management systems (QMS). Provides a framework for organizations to consistently provide products and services that meet customer and regulatory requirements.

controls.title: Understanding the organization and its context
controls.description: The organization shall determine external and internal issues that are relevant to its purpose and its strategic direction and that affect its ability to achieve the intended result(s) of its QMS.

controls.title: Needs and expectations of interested parties
controls.description: The organization shall determine the interested parties that are relevant to the QMS and their requirements.

controls.title: Leadership and commitment
controls.description: Top management shall demonstrate leadership and commitment with respect to the QMS by taking accountability for the effectiveness of the QMS.

controls.title: Quality policy
controls.description: Top management shall establish, implement, and maintain a quality policy that is appropriate to the purpose and context of the organization.

controls.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
controls.description: When planning for the QMS, the organization shall consider issues, requirements, and determine risks and opportunities that need to be addressed.

controls.title: Quality objectives
controls.description: The organization shall establish quality objectives at relevant functions, levels, and processes needed for the QMS.

controls.title: Resources
controls.description: The organization shall determine and provide the resources needed for the establishment, implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the QMS.

controls.title: Awareness
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that persons doing work under the organization's control are aware of the quality policy and relevant objectives.

controls.title: Documented information
controls.description: The organization's QMS shall include documented information required by this International Standard and determined by the organization as being necessary for the effectiveness of the QMS.

controls.title: Operational planning and control
controls.description: The organization shall plan, implement, control, monitor and review processes needed for the provision of products and services.

controls.title: Control of externally provided processes, products and services
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that externally provided processes, products and services conform to requirements.

controls.title: Production and service provision
controls.description: The organization shall implement production and service provision under controlled conditions.

controls.title: Control of nonconforming outputs
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that outputs that do not conform to their requirements are identified and controlled to prevent their unintended use or delivery.

controls.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
controls.description: The organization shall determine what needs to be monitored and measured, the methods for monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation needed to ensure valid results.

controls.title: Internal audit
controls.description: The organization shall conduct internal audits at planned intervals to provide information on whether the QMS conforms to requirements.

controls.title: Management review
controls.description: Top management shall review the organization's QMS at planned intervals, to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy, effectiveness and alignment with strategic direction.

controls.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
controls.description: When a nonconformity occurs, the organization shall react to the nonconformity, evaluate the need for action to eliminate the causes, and implement any actions needed.

controls.title: Continual improvement
controls.description: The organization shall continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the QMS.
